mapper.sql: s.id AS id, s.member_id AS memberId, s.staff_id AS staffId, s.member_name AS memberName, s.mobile AS mobile, s.teacher_name AS teacherName, s.tier AS tier, s.activity AS activity, s.days_since_class AS daysSinceClass, s.countcard_lessons AS countcardLessons, s.timecard_days_left AS timecardDaysLeft, s.timecard_expire AS timecardExpire, s.queue AS queue, s.sort_key AS sortKey, s.review_status AS reviewStatus, s.review_reason AS reviewReason, s.talk_script AS talkScript, s.dispatched_at AS dispatchedAt, (SELECT GROUP_CONCAT(f.reason_code ORDER BY f.reason_code) FROM followup_flag f WHERE f.snapshot_id = s.id) AS flags
mapper.select: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM followup_snapshot WHERE snapshot_date = AND review_status = 'PENDING'
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM followup_snapshot WHERE snapshot_date = AND review_status = 'PENDING' AND queue = 'RED'

SELECT f.reason_code AS reasonCode, COUNT(DISTINCT s.id) AS cnt FROM followup_flag f JOIN followup_snapshot s ON s.id = f.snapshot_id WHERE s.snapshot_date = AND s.review_status = 'PENDING' GROUP BY f.reason_code
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM followup_snapshot s WHERE s.snapshot_date = AND s.review_status = 'PENDING' AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM followup_flag f WHERE f.snapshot_id = s.id)

SELECT FROM followup_snapshot s WHERE s.snapshot_date = AND s.review_status = 'PENDING' AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM followup_flag f WHERE f.snapshot_id = s.id AND f.reason_code = #{reason}) ORDER BY s.sort_key, s.id LIMIT #{limit} OFFSET #{offset}
